info.title: USAspending API Awards: federal contract and grant awards
info.description:
Who won federal contracts and grants, and for how much? Pulls USAspending awards by agency, recipient, NAICS and period, with award IDs and source links.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper
Author: Public Records.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Start a run and read dataset items

post.description: Starts the Actor asynchronously. Poll the returned run, then read dataset items. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper

application/json.schema:
{
  "$schema": "https://apify.com/schemas/v1/input.ide.json",
  "title": "USASpending Awards Scraper",
  "description": "Public USASpending.gov spending_by_award API. Defaults to recent contracts/IDVs (A–D) over the last 30 days. Emphasize agency / recipient / date filters.",
  "type": "object",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "properties": {
    "keywords": {
      "title": "Keywords",
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Mapped to filters.keywords. Leave empty for broad recent awards; prefer agency/recipient/date.",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "default": [],
      "prefill": []
    },
    "naics": {
      "title": "NAICS codes",
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Mapped to filters.naics_codes.",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "default": []
    },
    "agency": {
      "title": "Awarding agency (toptier name)",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Toptier awarding agency name → filters.agencies[{type:awarding,tier:toptier,name}]. Example: Department of Defense.",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "default": "",
      "nullable": true,
      "prefill": "Department of Defense"
    },
    "recipient": {
      "title": "Recipient name",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Mapped to filters.recipient_search_text (array). Example: Boeing. Verified shape requires an array of strings.",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "default": "",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "awardTypes": {
      "title": "Award type codes",
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Default A,B,C,D (contracts/IDVs). Avoid assistance codes that may list individuals.",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "default": [
        "A",
        "B",
        "C",
        "D"
      ]
    },
    "startDate": {
      "title": "Start date",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today − 30 days (recent awards window).",
      "editor": "datepicker",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "endDate": {
      "title": "End date",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.",
      "editor": "datepicker",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "subawards": {
      "title": "Subawards mode",
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Pass subawards flag to search (default false).",
      "default": false
    },
    "fetchDetails": {
      "title": "Fetch award details",
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Hydrate via GET /awards/{generated_internal_id}/. Still one PPE charge.",
      "default": false
    },
    "maxItems": {
      "title": "Max items",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Cap on award rows (deduped by awardId|generatedInternalId).",
      "default": 50,
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 5000
    }
  }
}
